function: Complex CNN refines LS CSI estimates (CSI enhancement/denoising) of an uplink ISAC link, in the sparse angle-delay domain, minimizing CSI NMSE for demodulation and sensing (pp. 4-6).
system: Uplink OFDM ISAC: single-antenna UE, BS with 8-element ULA, 28 GHz, subcarrier spacing 480 kHz, L = 2 paths; no RIS (pp. 3, 8).
method: Complex-valued CNN (two ResNet-like blocks, FFT-based ISAC transforms), supervised with complex MSE loss on simulated CSI; AoA by MUSIC and range by biased FFT follow (pp. 4-6).
data_channel: Own simulated two-path channel (LoS plus scatterer), static and dynamic; 16 SNRs 0 to 15 dB, 2000 CSI each; 3/4 training, 1/4 evaluation, new test set (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained on dynamic-channel CSI, Nc = 256; tested on static and dynamic channels and Nc = 128, 256, 512; SNR 0 to 15 dB (pp. 9-10).
baselines: LS, LMMSE, DFT-based transform-domain method, dualCNN [22]; BER also against perfect CSI; LMMSE and dualCNN NMSE referenced to [22] (pp. 9-10).
metrics: CSI NMSE versus SNR, BER (4-QAM, 16-QAM) versus perfect-CSI reference, AoA MSE, range MSE, training loss per epoch (pp. 9-12).
complexity: Complexity orders (p. 6): enhancer between LS O(P Nc) and LMMSE O(2(P^2+P^3)Nc); biased FFT sensing O(Nr Nc log Nc) (p. 8); no runtime reported.
q1_support: p. 3: "the multi-path channel model for the MIMO-OFDM system"; custom model of Eq. 2 with parameters on p. 8 (28 GHz, L = 2, 8 x 1 BS); no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "trained by dynamic channel CSI data with Nc = 256 to enhance both the dynamic and static channel CSI data with various Nc"; Fig. 8 tests Nc = 128 and 512 with the model trained at Nc = 256.
q3_support: p. 9: "We choose the LS, LMMSE, DFT-based transform-domain, and the state-of-the-art dualCNN [22] CSI estimators as comparisons"; non-learned LS and LMMSE plus an earlier learned CSI estimator, compared on NMSE (Fig. 7) and BER.
q4_support: p. 6: "the complexity of the ISAC complex CNN CSI enhancer is between those for the LS and LMMSE methods"; orders O(P Nc) for LS and O[2(P^2+P^3)Nc] for LMMSE are given in Section III-D.
q5_support: p. 9: "we generate Ms = 2000 items of true CSI"; self-generated simulated CSI, and the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Area 2: channel estimation in an ISAC system. The CNN only refines the LS CSI; AoA by MUSIC and range by the biased FFT method are non-learned (pp. 6-8). q2 rests on Fig. 8 (p. 9) and its discussion (p. 10): other numbers of subcarriers than in training; the static channel is a special case of the dynamic training data (p. 9), so it is not counted as new. q3: the LMMSE and dualCNN NMSE values are referenced to [22], not re-simulated (pp. 9-10). No runtime or parameter count is reported. PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (arXiv:2305.17938v2); the DOI is not printed in the file.
